summary: The note follows first-time parents Natasha Johnson and Miguel Rivera through the first months after their son Gabriel's birth on September 15, 2023, and how they shared it on social media. A viral sneeze video, a vulnerable post about postpartum recovery, and a growing online community led them to curate their posts more carefully and to balance documenting with living in the moment. They come to see themselves as ambassadors of authentic parenthood.
one_line: First-time parents Natasha Johnson and Miguel Rivera document newborn Gabriel's first months online while learning to balance sharing with being present.
key_facts: Natasha Johnson and Miguel Rivera became first-time parents on September 15, 2023, when their son Gabriel was born.
Gabriel's first social media post was taken at St. Mary's Hospital, showing him in a baby blue swaddle framed by his parents' faces.
On September 28, 2023, a video of Gabriel's unexpected sneeze, posted on a Wednesday afternoon, unexpectedly went viral.
The viral clip made the couple weigh the merits and responsibility of sharing their newborn's life with the world.
By October 2023 the Rivera family had a more structured approach to social media, choosing each photo and video carefully.
Gabriel's first Halloween costume on October 31, 2023 was a tiny astronaut suit.
On November 20, 2023, Natasha shared a late-night feeding session and opened up about her struggles with postpartum recovery, which drew a flood of compassion from other moms.
By late November, followers from across the globe offered encouragement and parenting hacks, forming a 'virtual village'.
December milestones celebrated in posts included Gabriel's first laugh, holding his head up, and eye contact.
By January 2024 the couple reflected on how they documented Gabriel's growth and sought to balance the digital narrative with private family moments.
Other parents began sharing their own stories, inspired by the couple's candid portrayal of life with a newborn.
In February, Valentine's Day was celebrated with handmade cards featuring Gabriel's footprint.
The couple became 'accidental ambassadors of authentic parenthood', with the message to embrace each moment.
